div.div:
Message Headers (Routing & Infrastructure Metadata):
• Message ID: Unique message identifier (UUID)
• Correlation ID: Associates reply with initiating request
• Return Address: Callback channel name (reply-to)
• Sequence Identifier: Part index, total count, stream offset
• Expiration (TTL): Epoch expiration timestamp
• Format Indicator: MIME type, schema identifier

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 468px; height: 1px; padding-top: 233px; margin-left: 53px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;

div.div:
Message Body / Payload (Domain Business Content):
• Uninterpreted byte array, serialized XML, or JSON payload
• Mediators inspect headers without deserializing the body (zero-copy routing)

div.div: Key Rule: Infrastructure reads headers; business logic reads the body.

div.div:
CloudEvents Required & Optional Context Attributes:
• id: Unique event ID • source: URI reference of emitter
• specversion: "1.0" • type: Domain event schema name
• datacontenttype: "application/avro" or "application/json"
• dataschema: URL to Avro/Protobuf schema definition in registry
• traceparent: W3C distributed tracing context propagation header
